answer: Admission auction: 200 slots open each epoch; sealed bids set the clearing price. A newcomer waits in an island queue, cut off from rewards until its bid clears. Even at the nadir of demand the price locks a stake for 20 epochs, and each winner posts a marble bond, burned if its referrals form a star cluster. Making 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 prices and 1,000 bonds, about 2,000,000 credits; one honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
